The '''Spinward sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

It contained a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where the [[polwocz]] lived.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
